title: Article 2A — Sikkim to be associated with the Union (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 2A (Sikkim to be associated with the Union) was a short-lived provision. It was inserted by the Constitution (Thirty-fifth Amendment) Act, 1974 when Sikkim became an Associate State, and omitted by the Constitution (Thirty-sixth Amendment) Act, 1975 when Sikkim became a full State of the Union. Special provisions for Sikkim now appear in Article 371F.
content.glance: Art 2A omitted by 36th Amendment 1975. Sikkim is a full State; special provisions are in Article 371F.
content.study:
Article 2A created an intermediate ‘Associate State’ status for Sikkim under the 35th Amendment (1974), together with a related Tenth Schedule arrangement.

Omission: Constitution (Thirty-sixth Amendment) Act, 1975 omitted Article 2A, removed the Associate-State framework, added Sikkim to the First Schedule as a State, and inserted Article 371F with special provisions for Sikkim.

Examination rule: Do not cite Article 2A as living law. For Sikkim’s current constitutional position, cite Article 1, the First Schedule, and Article 371F.

sections.heading: Constitutional status and amendments
sections.body:
Inserted: Constitution (Thirty-fifth Amendment) Act, 1974 — Associate State status for Sikkim.
Omitted: Constitution (Thirty-sixth Amendment) Act, 1975 — full statehood; Article 2A and the related Tenth Schedule arrangement removed.
Living framework: Sikkim is a State under Article 1 and the First Schedule; special provisions are in Article 371F.

sections.heading: Exam checkpoints
sections.body:
1. Distinguish 35th Amendment (Associate State / Art 2A) from 36th Amendment (full State / Art 2A omitted / Art 371F).
2. Do not treat Article 2A as current law.
3. For modern Sikkim questions, use Article 371F and ordinary State provisions as modified by that article.

examples.title: Illustration — Status after 1975
examples.body: A 2026 petition that relies on Article 2A to describe Sikkim’s status is misconceived. Article 2A stands omitted. The correct frame is full statehood under the First Schedule with special provisions in Article 371F.

misconceptions.trap: Article 2A still governs Sikkim’s relationship with the Union.
misconceptions.correction: Article 2A was omitted by the 36th Amendment, 1975. Sikkim is a full State; see Article 371F for special provisions.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the present status of Article 2A?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 2A was omitted by the Constitution (Thirty-sixth Amendment) Act, 1975 after Sikkim became a full State. It is not living law. Special provisions for Sikkim are in Article 371F.

examTips: Pair 35th (insert Associate State) with 36th (omit Art 2A; full State; Art 371F).

keyTakeaways: Sikkim is a full State; special provisions in Art 371F.
